lines.text: Leaving Jericho with a large crowd, Jesus and His disciples pass a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus.
Bartimaeus cries out to Jesus, Son of David, for mercy, and when many people tell him to be silent, he shouts louder.
Jesus stops and says, "Call him," and the people tell Bartimaeus to stay put and wait there.
Bartimaeus throws off his sandals and comes to Jesus, who asks what he wants, and he asks to see again.
Jesus tells him his faith has healed him, and he immediately receives his sight and follows Jesus along the road.
